a/Includes other causes not specified and missing and unknown causes.

c/Includes other specified illnesses (such as cerebrovascular disease, influenza, and other nonleading natural causes of death) and unspecified illnesses.
d/Includes homicides committed by other prisoners, incidental to the use of force by staff, and resulting from assaults sustained prior to incarceration.
e/Excludes persons of Hispanic origin (e.g., “white” refers to non-Hispanic whites and “black” refers to non-Hispanic blacks).
f/Includes Asians, Native Hawaiians, and Other Pacific Islanders.
